lesson.title: Akhaan: ਸਬਰ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਮਿੱਠਾ + Composition
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: You've learned two proverbs. Today: a third, plus writing your own composition using one!

ਸਬਰ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਮਿੱਠਾ literally means 'the fruit of patience is sweet' — it's used to encourage patience, teaching that waiting and staying calm through a difficulty leads to a good result. Choose one of this week's three proverbs (ਦੂਰ ਦੇ ਢੋਲ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ, ਘਰ ਦੀ ਮੁਰਗ਼ੀ ਦਾਲ ਬਰਾਬਰ, or ਸਬਰ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਮਿੱਠਾ) and write 3-4 sentences telling a short story where a character learns that proverb's lesson.
You just wrote your own composition using a real Punjabi proverb! Tomorrow we'll review all three.

objectives: Understand the meaning of ਸਬਰ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਮਿੱਠਾ
Write an original short story correctly applying one of this week's three proverbs
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's first two proverbs briefly.
2. Introduce ਸਬਰ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਮਿੱਠਾ.
3. Have the child choose one of the three proverbs and write a short story applying it.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: help the child pick the proverb they understood most clearly this week before starting the story
Ready for more: ask the child to write a story that could apply to two of the week's proverbs at once
This is the week's synthesis moment — actually applying a proverb correctly in an original story is the genuinely important literary skill here
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended composition activity — check that the child's 3-4 sentence story clearly demonstrates the chosen proverb's specific lesson, not just a generic story with the proverb tacked on.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's literature-excerpts and composition threads together, completing this week's proverb sequence before tomorrow's review.
